summary: Configured reliable, filtered TCP forwarding of node2 `inventory` messages to `/var/log/inventory/node2.log` on node1. Both nodes were restarted sequentially; boot IDs changed and end-to-end logging recovered after each restart.
actions_performed: Configured node1 rsyslog to listen on 10.100.43.10:601 and persist only node2 inventory messages.
Restricted TCP/601 in firewalld to node2’s source address; SELinux remained enforcing.
Configured node2 with a persistent disk-queued TCP forwarder selecting only the `inventory` program tag.
Validated configurations and tested positive and negative message paths.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified boot identity changes, service recovery, retained data, and fresh log delivery.
Confirmed the RHEL release and kernel were unchanged, SSH remained active, and no failed units, rsyslog warnings, or restart-test residue remained.

evidence.requirement: Centralized inventory log forwarding and filtering
evidence.summary: Inventory-tagged messages were transmitted and persisted; non-inventory control messages were excluded before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Persistent node1 collector with narrow network exposure
evidence.summary: Configuration validates, rsyslog is enabled and bound to 10.100.43.10:601, and firewalld permits only node2. The protected log contains all required test messages.
The disk-queued forwarding configuration validates, is enabled, and re-established its TCP session after restart.
Healthy baseline boot ID d9f8550d-5cb3-4929-9e62-a388df86bcf6; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 3e9f91ae-e506-4c67-8d35-f226e4089799; listener, firewall, retained data, and fresh delivery recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID d49beed9-f2bc-4611-892b-e25e35071bc5; reboot acknowledged; new boot ID 72ce058f-4d46-45e2-8d1c-37747179284e; forwarding service, connection, and fresh end-to-end delivery recovered.

evidence.requirement: OS, kernel, security, and administrative access preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64; SSH is active, SELinux enforcing, firewalld running, and final checks show no failed units or rsyslog warnings.
